summary: Readiness review for iteration `welcome-email` succeeded. The prerequisite `registration-profile-consent` is implemented and source-verified: `User.firstName`/`User.lastName` exist in Prisma schema and migration, registration actions capture profile names, and `src/auth.ts` distinguishes existing provider accounts from first-time Google registration with consent gating. Gmail configuration prerequisites are present in `.env.local` as key names `GMAIL_USER`, `GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD`, and `GMAIL_FROM` without exposing values. No mail sender dependency is installed yet (`npm.cmd ls nodemailer @types/nodemailer --depth=0` returned empty), but that is expected delivery work, not a blocker. A clean implementation path exists: add a server-only injectable Gmail sender, trigger welcome delivery only from a new-user creation path such as Auth.js `createUser` handling, catch/log email failures so registration still succeeds, and unit-test duplicate avoidance and failure behavior with a mocked sender. Checks run successfully: `npm.cmd ls next next-auth @auth/prisma-adapter @prisma/client prisma typescript --depth=0`, `npx.cmd prisma validate`, `npx.cmd tsc --noEmit --incremental false`, and `node --test .ai_factory\tests\unit\registration\registration-profile-consent-source.test.mjs` with 4/4 passing. Browser verification, Playwright, e2e tests, app server startup, deployment, publishing, and real email sending were not run per task constraints.
